title: Schedule
description: Represents a scheduled time for a site visit with assigned supervisor and workers.

siteId.description: Reference to the Site to be visited.

siteName.description: Denormalized site name for display purposes.

startTime.description: Start time of the scheduled visit (ISO 8601 datetime string).

endTime.description: End time of the scheduled visit (ISO 8601 datetime string).

supervisorId.description: Reference to User (Supervisor) assigned to this schedule. Required for authorization.

workerIds.description: Array of User IDs (Workers) assigned to this schedule. Required for authorization.

status.description: The current status of the schedule.

notes.description: Additional notes or instructions for this scheduled visit.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the schedule was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the schedule was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
